proof_roadmap: 第 1 步：This lemma is a generalization of Groupoids, Lemma \refgroupoids-lemma-colimit-kappa which deals with the case of a groupoid in schemes.
第 2 步：Choose a scheme W and a surjective \'etale morphism W \to U.

items.difficulty_reason: H2: For a groupoid in arbitrary algebraic spaces with flat s,t, construct a set of equivariant quasi-coherent objects whose isomorphic subobjects exhaust every object by directed colimit. Mandatory author proof1495-1603 refines a flat scheme diagram to affine charts, chooses finite lifts along comparison isomorphisms, and iteratively closes generating sets while retaining a common cardinal bound; this yields bounded crystals. The final1615-1691 proof then constructs the specific five-scheme diagram from etale covers of U and the two relation projections, defines its comparison map using the groupoid action, proves faithful exactness and a bijection of subobjects by descent, and obtains a set of bounded isomorphism classes. This actual crystal-closure plus descent construction is counted once. The author explicitly cannot use the scheme-groupoid argument unchanged; original omitted details are retained. The three-page PDF has only the final groupoid proof; the mandatory crystal proof is native and not hidden as a prerequisite.
